description: This file implements a HAR (HTTP Archive) tracer for Playwright, capturing network requests, responses, and page load events to generate a HAR log. It manages event listeners, creates HAR entries, processes request/response data, and handles content embedding or attachment based on options.

classes.name: HarTracer
classes.description: A class that captures network activity and page load events to generate a HAR log, supporting start, stop, and flush operations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the HAR tracer with context, page, delegate, and options.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins capturing network and page events based on provided options.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops capturing events, removes listeners, and generates the HAR log.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Waits for all ongoing event processing to complete.
